frameCheck.calculationMethod: WGS84 lon/lat bbox containment; distances via spherical haversine with mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m. Width evaluated along frame mid-latitude, height along center longitude; rounded to 0.1 m.

dareRelation.interpretation: Only a coordinate arithmetic comparison to a low-precision settlement-level gazetteer anchor. This does not certify frame contents, city edge, dry ground, an ancient street, or accession venue.

modernRiverControl.dataset: Natural Earth 10m river/lake centerlines GeoJSON; local manifest ID ne-odyssey-rivers10m; public domain; source page https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-physical-vectors/10m-rivers-lake-centerlines/; raw URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_rivers_lake_centerlines.geojson

frameIntersection.method: local equirectangular projection centered on frame; straight-segment/rectangle calculation; approximate, suitable only for regional separation check

modernRiverControl.finding: The named modern generalized Sava feature intersects the parent regional bbox but does not intersect the candidate frame. Its nearest generalized segment is approximately 411 m south of the frame southwest corner. The candidate therefore has no river-line geometry inside it in this dataset; the Sava is nearby in the parent-level context. This is not evidence for or against a 379 shoreline, wetland, water depth, navigability, ford, bridge, or dry terrain. Profile has no dedicated Sirmium waterControlLine geometry field.

limits: Frame inclusion is a bounding-box calculation only; it does not select or certify any terrain.
DARE point is published with 2,000 m precision and is settlement-level, not an exact archaeological site point.
Natural Earth is present-day generalized hydrography, not ancient Sava banks. It is not a surveyed or high-resolution local channel.
Neither image establishes ancient street, wall, palace footprint, 379 appearance, or event location; both records state productionApproved=false.
No route, district, gameplay marker, historic coordinate, or map layout is selected.
